ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region dominated by a contiguous white field. High-contrast black banding along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant yellowish-brown contiguous blobs (likely bio-fouling) occupy the mid-lateral sections of both lobes. Multiple discrete black focal spots are distributed across the white field, with higher density in the lower-central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 75 degrees and a bounding-box depth equal to roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations visible across the entire trailing edge. Extreme high-amplitude pixel variations (jaggedness) are concentrated on the far-left distal margin, indicating irregular contour compared to the smoother right tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a convex curve trajectory from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized, roughly circular dark pixel clusters (5-15 pixels in diameter) concentrated near the fluke insertion point and lower midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged material loss on the far-left fluke tip. Extensive yellowish surface discoloration patches distributed bilaterally on the lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific cluster of four dark spots forming a vertical column on the lower-left central quadrant of the fluke.
